Definition: Telem, the name of a place in Idumaea, also of a temple doorkeeper
BiblicalUsage: Telem = "oppression"; n pr m; 1) a gatekeeper among the returning exiles in the time of Ezra; n pr loc; 2) one of the cities in the extreme south of Judah in the Negeb
